notes: The opening waw takes the postpositive *also*; distance is not evidence against it (rule 51). The italic *yet* opens a clause with no conjunction morpheme and stays `added` (rules 14, 55).
מַה־שֶּׁ → *what* and מֵאַחֲרָיו → *after* are fusions under rule 30; the compound preposition heads on the governing morpheme standing first (rule 23), as מֵאֵת → *of* does.
The dative לְ is silenced by the bare indirect object *tell him*, its suffix keeping the pronoun (rule 40).
